title: Microsoft Teams: real-time call queue metrics in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, licensing and existing controls are supported, and the changed release notes still contain the June mobile-metrics statement it flags. The categorical description of the metrics as read-only remains unconfirmed; minor corrections concern rollout wording, an abbreviated policy path and checklist coverage.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsVoiceApplicationsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -RealTimeCallQueueMetricsPermission AuthorizedOnly grants the relevant authorized-queue metrics access.
claims.quote:
### -RealTimeCallQueueMetricsPermission
Supported values: Disabled | AuthorizedOnly | All
When set to AuthorizedOnly, users affected by the policy will receive real-time metrics for call queues they are authorized for.

claims.claim: The policy setting is named Real-time call queue metrics.
claims.quote: | Real-time call queue metrics | This setting allows authorized users to access real-time call queue metrics. | RealTimeQueueMetricsPermission | Yes |

claims.claim: None is the policy page's no-access reporting value.

claims.fix: Replace 'values None, AuthorizedOnly (All no longer supported)' with 'The policy page lists None and AuthorizedOnly; the PowerShell reference uses Disabled rather than None. All is no longer supported.' The cited Set-CsTeamsVoiceApplicationsPolicy reference documents Disabled under -RealTimeCallQueueMetricsPermission.

claims.claim: AuthorizedOnly limits metrics to the queues and related entities the user is authorized for.

claims.claim: All is no longer supported for real-time call queue metrics.
claims.quote: The All option is no longer supported. The parameter will be accepted and saved however any user assigned a policy with RealTimeCallQueueMetricsPermission set to All will not be able to access real-time metrics.
